channels.title: Channels
channels.description: One or more channels: a handle (@MrBeast), a channel url or a channel id (UC...). Each channel is read once and gives its own rows.

maxVideosPerChannel.title: Max videos per channel
maxVideosPerChannel.description: Stop after this many videos for each channel. Paging follows the page's own continuation token, about 30 videos per page.

region.title: Region
region.description: Two letter country code that shapes the mix, for example US or DE.

language.title: Language
language.description: Two letter language code for titles and labels, for example en or de.
